item.title: Bedroom Organization: A Step-by-Step Under-Bed Storage Makeover With 48 Inches of Clearance
item.description: Under-bed storage is one of the easiest ways to gain usable space in a small bedroom, but only when the system is measured around the actual bed. A 48-inch clearance sounds generous, yet the useful opening may be much smaller once the frame, drawers, skirting, and nearby furniture are considered. This guide treats the project like a small installation rather than a decorating exercise. You will measure the space, sort what belongs there, select containers, test the clearance, and build a simple retrieval system.
